verdict.rationale: Skyfire's pay and kya-pay tokens are signed, limited-use credentials given to agents in place of raw card numbers. Each token has a committed amount ceiling, and charges above its remaining balance are rejected. Tokens also have a 10-second-to-24-hour expiry and authorize payment to a specific seller; in the card flow, the authorization covers a specific merchant and amount as a ceiling, with tokenized card transactions. Missing for 10: a per-token revocation API (in-flight tokens stay chargeable until expiry plus a 24-hour grace period), explicit documentation that non-card pay tokens are bound to a single seller, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
